title: ⭐ The IELTS Band Score System

sections.heading: How bands work
sections.body:
IELTS scores range from Band 1 (non-user) to Band 9 (expert user).
Scores are given in 0.5 increments: 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, 7.5, 8.0, 8.5, 9.0

Each skill (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) gets its own band.
Your Overall Band = average of all four, rounded to the nearest 0.5

sections.heading: What each band means
sections.body:
Band 9: Expert — uses English with full operational proficiency
Band 8: Very Good — fully operational with only occasional unsystematic inaccuracies
Band 7: Good — operational command; occasional inaccuracies and misunderstandings
Band 6: Competent — generally effective; some inaccuracies and misunderstandings
Band 5: Modest — partial command; copes with overall meaning
Band 4 and below: Limited command

highlight: Most universities require Band 6.5–7.5 overall. Check your specific institution's requirement — and note whether they require minimum scores per skill (e.g. 'at least 6.0 in Writing').

question: You score: Listening 7.5, Reading 6.5, Writing 6.0, Speaking 7.0. What is your Overall Band?
explanation:
Overall = (7.5 + 6.5 + 6.0 + 7.0) ÷ 4 = 27.0 ÷ 4 = 6.75

IELTS rounds to the nearest 0.5:
6.75 rounds UP to 7.0 ✅

Rounding rules:
• 0.25 → rounds down to the lower 0.5
• 0.75 → rounds up to the higher 0.5
• 0.5 → stays as 0.5
hint: Calculate the average, then round to the nearest 0.5.

question: A university requires 'Band 7.0 overall with no skill below 6.0.' You score L:7.5, R:7.0, W:5.5, S:7.0. Do you meet the requirement?
options: No — Writing is below the minimum 6.0
No — you need 7.0 in every skill
correct: No — Writing is below the minimum 6.0
explanation:
Overall: (7.5 + 7.0 + 5.5 + 7.0) ÷ 4 = 27.0 ÷ 4 = 6.75 → rounds to 7.0 ✅
BUT Writing = 5.5 < 6.0 minimum ❌

Many institutions have BOTH:
• An overall minimum AND
• Per-skill minimums

Always check both requirements. A strong overall score won't compensate for one weak skill if there's a per-skill minimum.
hint: Check both the overall AND the per-skill minimums.

question: Your current overall band is 6.0. What is the minimum improvement needed across all skills to reach Band 7.0?
options: Improve all four skills by an average of 1.0 band
You cannot improve from 6.0 to 7.0 — it requires a different test
correct: Improve all four skills by an average of 1.0 band
explanation:
Going from Band 6.0 to Band 7.0 requires the AVERAGE of four skills to increase by 1.0.

This could mean:
• All four skills +1.0 each
• Two skills +2.0, two skills unchanged
• Or any combination that adds 4.0 total across all skills

Most efficient: focus on your weakest skill — it gives the best return on study time.
hint: The overall band is an average — what must the average increase by?

question: Which statement about IELTS band scores is CORRECT?
options: Listening and Reading are marked out of 40 and converted to a band
Writing and Speaking bands are determined purely by word/word count
All four skills are marked independently on a 1–9 scale
Your overall band is always the same as your lowest skill band
correct: All four skills are marked independently on a 1–9 scale
explanation:
Each skill is assessed independently:
🎧 Listening: 40 questions → raw score converted to band
👁️ Reading: 40 questions → raw score converted to band
✍️ Writing: examiner marks using 4 criteria → band
🗣️ Speaking: examiner marks using 4 criteria → band

All four feed into the overall average.
